paragraphs.text: Regatha is the plane where the Order of Heliud was founded.

Regatha is known for a magical phenomenon called the Purifying Fire . Parts of Regatha are highly volcanic, and wildlife like the Embermaw Hellion has adapted to living in fiery conditions. For certain periods, Jaya Ballard and Chandra Nalaar made it their home.
The Great Sea - an unnamed body of water traversed by the Order of Heliud.
The Great Western Wood - east of Mount Keralia, home to reclusive elves , human druids , and many other races. Led by an inter-tribal council.

The Keralian Mountains - a mountain range of which Mount Keralia is the most prominent peak. Mount Keralia - the sacred mountain on which Keral Keep is built. Keral Keep - a monastery founded by followers of Jaya Ballard .
The Sleeping Mountain - a volcano that last erupted circa 4561 AR
Thold - The City where Heliud was from, across the Great Sea from Zinara.

Zinara - the plains city east of the Great Western Wood. An attractive city of tidy, pale stone buildings, spiraling towers, neatly-paved streets, and red-tiled roofs. Ruled by the Order of Heliud . The Temple of Heliud - the main headquarters of the Order, a massive, marble-pillared edifice. The Purifying Fire - a large, cold-burning bonfire that cleanses those who enter it of their past sins. Those who cannot become pure never leave it.
